Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. The "field" refers to both the breeding area and the battle area.
Card Q&A.q: Can I use a "Digimon on the field may digivolve" effect to digivolve a Digimon from the breeding area or battle area?
If I use this card's [Your Turn] effect to digivolve a Digimon in the breeding area, does that Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect trigger?

Effect: [Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.

[Your Turn] When one of your [Chronicle] trait Digimon attacks, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon on the field may digivolve into a level 6 or lower [Chronicle] trait Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 1.
(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Kota Domoto]/[Yuji Musya].
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
